Searching the project for the local replenishment policy and how net stock of 60 is handled.


**Hold steady** — do not recommend replenishment.

Under the local replenishment policy in `docs/policy.md`, replenishment is recommended only when net stock (available minus reserved) is **below** 60 individual units. At **exactly** 60 you are at the threshold, not under it, so the policy says to hold steady.

Other rules from the same policy still apply if they come up: convert cases only with current lot-specific units per case; if conversion or reservation units are unknown, hold pending clarification; and prefer current connected records over cached exports (`depot://stock/west`, `depot://reservations/west`).
